description: Camoufox hooks - redirect WebSearch/WebFetch to camoufox CLI browser automation (no-op when the CLI is not installed)

hooks.command:
command -v "${CAMOUFOX_CLI:-camoufox}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; cat <<'EOF'
{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "SessionStart", "additionalContext": "## Camoufox Browser CLI Available

The `camoufox` CLI drives a real, fingerprint-resistant Firefox. Use it via Bash instead of `WebSearch` / `WebFetch` : it renders JavaScript, keeps cookies, and can click and fill forms.

```bash
B=camoufox   # or $CAMOUFOX_CLI
# Browser: $CAMOUFOX_BIN, else the active/newest fetched install (automatic lookup)
# 1. Ensure the daemon is running (backgrounded, output to a log)
$B ping >/dev/null 2>&1 || { ($B serve >/tmp/camoufox-daemon.log 2>&1 &); sleep 1; }
# 2. Reuse an instance or launch one
I=$($B list --json | jq -r '.data.instances[0].instance_id // empty')
[ -n "$I" ] || I=$($B launch ${CAMOUFOX_BIN:+--executable "$CAMOUFOX_BIN"} --json | jq -r .data.instance_id)
# 3. Page + navigate
P=$($B new-page "$I" --json | jq -r .data.page_id)
$B navigate "$I" "$P" '<url>' --wait-until load --timeout 20 --json
# 4. Read it
$B text "$I" "$P"          # rendered text; --selector/--frame to narrow
$B data "$I" "$P" --og     # quick summary metadata
```

For search, navigate to `https://duckduckgo.com/?q=<url_encoded_query>`; for a fetch, navigate straight to the URL.

Load the `camoufox-browse` skill for the full command reference (upload, record/replay cassettes, launch --profile-dir, iframes, shadow DOM, dialogs, downloads, cookies, screenshots). JSON errors include kind; --socket overrides CAMOUFOX_SOCKET."}}
EOF
